about_the_game:
Have you ever dreamed of running your own cleaning company, where you decide which jobs to take and how to grow your business? Now you have the chance to try it in House Cleaner Simulator Demo - a unique simulation that lets you experience the satisfaction of cleanliness and a job well done!

In this demo version, you will start from humble beginnings: establish your first company, accept client orders, and head out with your own car. You’ll face a variety of places to clean - houses, restaurants, offices, and warehouses – from simple mopping to more demanding tasks requiring focus and precision.

But cleaning is just the beginning. During the game, you’ll earn money that can be invested in better equipment. This will make each job faster, smoother, and more professional.

What does House Cleaner Simulator Demo offer?

  • Relaxing and satisfying gameplay - cleaning can be surprisingly calming, rewarding, and profitable.

  • Start your own cleaning business - begin your career and build the best company in town.

  • First client jobs - discover how diverse the needs of city residents can be.

  • A car at your disposal - travel between jobs and explore your surroundings.

  • Obtain and upgrade equipment - from simple tools to advanced solutions.

  • Earn money and grow your company - the better you clean, the more you can invest in your future.

Demo limitations

  • 5 in-game days available

  • Gameplay set in the first city

House Cleaner Simulator Demo is the perfect opportunity to discover the basics of the game and see how satisfying it can be to run your own cleaning company. If you enjoy tidying up virtual spaces and growing your business, the full version will offer even more jobs, equipment, and possibilities!
